Package com.sai.recipeservice.controller

Class RecipeController

java.lang.Object
com.sai.recipeservice.controller.RecipeController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/recipes") public class RecipeController extends Object
REST controller exposing endpoints for managing the recipe lifecycle and orchestrating automated master ingredient synchronization.

This controller serves as the primary entry boundary for recipe data and interacts directly with the underlying RecipeService to persist and fetch records. All endpoint responses are configured with SpringDoc OpenAPI metadata for documentation rendering.

1.0

    • createRecipe

      @PostMapping("/create") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Recipe> createRecipe(@RequestBody Recipe recipe)
      Persists a new recipe entity and synchronizes its constituent components with the global master ingredient dictionary registry.
      Parameters:
      recipe - the structural recipe data object containing name, servings, instructions, and relational ingredient metadata arrays
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity wrapping the newly created Recipe and an HTTP status of 201 Created

    • getAllRecipes

      @GetMapping("/getall") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<Recipe>> getAllRecipes()
      Retrieves all recipe records present in the database.

      This endpoint fetches the complete list of recipes, including their nested contextual ingredients and mapped master definitions.

      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a List of all managed Recipe entities and an HTTP status of 200 OK

    • deleteRecipe

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> deleteRecipe(@PathVariable Long id)
      Removes a specific recipe entity from the system by its unique identifier.

      Dependent child ingredients mapped to this recipe container are handled according to the underlying JPA cascade configuration boundaries.

      Parameters:
      id - the unique database Long ID of the recipe to be deleted
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing an operational status message string and an HTTP status of 204 No Content upon a successful deletion transaction

    • getRecipeIdsByIngredient

      @GetMapping("/ingredient/{name}/recipes") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<Long>> getRecipeIdsByIngredient(@PathVariable String name)
      NEW ENDPOINT: Link Master Ingredient to Recipe IDs This fulfills the requirement of finding all recipes containing a specific ingredient.

      The input parameter string name is case-normalized to lower-case characters prior to querying the service engine layer to maintain data retrieval parity.

      * @param name the textual string name of the master ingredient to search against
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a List of unique Long recipe IDs that contain the specified master ingredient, alongside an HTTP status of 200 OK

    • updateRecipeById

      @PatchMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Recipe> updateRecipeById(@PathVariable Long id, @RequestBody Recipe recipeu)
      Updates specific structural details of an existing recipe record.

      This applies partial or complete updates to the recipe target identified by the path parameter based on the incoming request body payload wrapper.

      Parameters:
      id - the unique database Long ID of the recipe to modify
      recipeu - the incoming recipe data structure carrying the updated field mutations
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity wrapping the updated, managed Recipe entity instance and an HTTP status of 200 OK
